description: This file contains extension methods for reading variable-width integers (varints) and other integer types from a binary reader, with support for different wire types and efficient decoding techniques. It is part of the Orleans serialization utilities.

classes.name: VarIntReaderExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to read variable-width integers and other integer types from a Reader object in Orleans serialization.

methods.name: ReadVarInt8
methods.description: Reads a variable-width sbyte from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarInt16
methods.description: Reads a variable-width short (Int16) from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarUInt8
methods.description: Reads a variable-width byte (UInt8) from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarUInt16
methods.description: Reads a variable-width ushort (UInt16) from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarInt32
methods.description: Reads a variable-width int (Int32) from the reader.

methods.name: ReadVarInt64
methods.description: Reads a variable-width long (Int64) from the reader.

methods.name: ReadUInt8
methods.description: Reads a byte value depending on the specified wire type (VarInt, Fixed32, Fixed64, or LengthPrefixed).

methods.name: ReadUInt16
methods.description: Reads a ushort value depending on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt32
methods.description: Reads a uint value depending on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadUInt64
methods.description: Reads a ulong value depending on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt8
methods.description: Reads an sbyte value depending on the specified wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt16
methods.description: Reads a short (Int16) depending on the wire type.

methods.name: ReadInt32
methods.description: Reads an int (Int32) depending on the wire type, with a fallback slower path.

methods.name: ReadInt64
methods.description: Reads a long (Int64) depending on the wire type.
